name: Qretu 5
description: Qretu 5 was a bacta refinement planet in the Inner Rim's Qretu system, loyal to Ysanne Isard during the Bacta War.
lead_paragraphs: Qretu 5 was a bacta refinement planet in the Inner Rim's Qretu system, loyal to Ysanne Isard during the Bacta War.
The planet hosted the Q5A7 Bacta Refinement Plant, which was destroyed by a punitive strike conducted by Rogue Squadron soon after the Battle of Halanit.
